{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or low (e.g., < 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day true values show strong mean reversion or downward momentum.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive and price has recently spiked (e.g., > 0.67), to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply upward bias correction if true values consistently exceed model forecasts by > 2% over 3 consecutive days, especially with positive sentiment.",
    "Use sentiment as a momentum filter: if sentiment > 0.50, model should be more aggressive; if < 0.33, model should be more conservative.",
    "Cap forecast growth rate at 3% per day for high sentiment periods to prevent overreaction to short-term volatility.",
    "If true outcome is 10%+ below model forecast for 5+ days, apply a downward drift correction (e.g., linear regression to recent 10-day mean)."
  ]
}
